sys_variable_value.value:
SELECT s.[CD_SIS] [cd_sistema] ,s.[DE_SIS] [de_descricao] ,s.[SQ_SIS] [sq_interna] ,s.[SG_SIS] [sg_sis] ,ISNULL(st.[NM_ST], 'Em produção') [st_sistema] ,s.[DT_CAD_SIS] [dt_cadastro] ,s.[MT_USU_CAD] [mat_cadastro] ,s.[DT_ULT_ALT] [dt_ult_alt] ,s.[MT_USU_ALT] [mat_ult_alt] ,s.[DT_PRI_IPT] [dt_pri_impl] ,s.[DT_ULT_IPT] [dt_ult_impl] ,s.[DT_DST] [dt_desativ] ,s.[DT_SUS] [dt_suspen] ,CAST(s.[CD_ORG_DSV] AS NVARCHAR(40)) [dep_desenv_1] ,CAST(s.[CD_ORG_DSV_SEC] AS NVARCHAR(40)) [dep_desenv_2] ,s.[MT_RSP_DSV] [mat_desenv_1] ,s.[MT_RSP_DSV_SEC] [mat_desenv_2] ,s.[NM_SIS] [nm_sistema] ,s.[NM_POR] [nm_porte] ,s.[NM_CAT] [nm_categoria] ,s.[NM_MOD] [nm_modalidade] ,s.[NM_AQT] [nm_arquitetura] ,s.[NM_LOC_PRC] [nm_local_processamento] ,s.[NM_ORI_SIS] [nm_origem_sistema] ,s.[NM_FAB_SIS] [nm_fabricante] ,s.[ID_SEG] [tf_iskey] ,s.[ID_PRC_NOT] [tf_proc_noturno] ,s.[NM_NIV_CRI] [nm_nivel_criticidade] ,CAST(s.[CD_ORG_GES] AS NVARCHAR(40)) [dep_gestor] ,s.[MT_GES_RSP] [mat_gestor] ,s.[CD_PRJ] [cd_projeto] ,s.[ID_PGT_01] [tf_obriga_homo] ,s.[ID_PGT_02] [tf_processo_critico_negocio] ,s.[ID_PGT_03] [tf_caminho_critico_processamento] ,s.[ID_PGT_04] [tf_publica_piloto_prod] ,s.[ID_PGT_05] [tf_pergunta_05] ,STUFF(( SELECT CHAR(10) + c.[MT_CDR] FROM [DCSI047].[dbo].[T047COO] AS c WHERE c.[SQ_SIS] = s.[SQ_SIS] ORDER BY c.[MT_CDR] FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') [coordenadores]
FROM [DCSI047].[dbo].[T047SIST] AS s LEFT JOIN [DCSI047].[dbo].[T047STAT] AS st ON st.[SQ_ST] = s.[ST_SIS]
ORDER BY s.[CD_SIS]
